# About This Volume {.unnumbered .unlisted}

This is **Volume 2 of 3** of *Biostatistics Practicum*. The book is
also published whole, as a single continuously numbered site, at
<https://practicum.rgtlab.org>. The print edition is split into
three volumes only because a single bound book would be too long to
handle comfortably.

**This volume**, *Documents, Pipelines, and Communication*, covers
Quarto documents, targets pipelines, and cloud compute,
communicating a finished analysis, and federal requirements. It
assumes the project environment (renv, Docker, and the compendium)
set up in Volume 1. It also carries the
book's full set of appendices. These are the glossary, cheat
sheets, the instructor guide, the rgtlab software appendix, the
tooling-as-of appendix, the R Markdown migration guide, interactive
deliverables, credits, and the colophon. We keep them here, in one
place, instead of duplicating them in all three volumes.

**Volume 1**, *Data, Toolkit, and a First Look*, opens with the
two worked case studies and the HF-HOME capstone as a preview,
then covers why reproducible research matters, team science, the
toolkit (including renv, Docker, and the compendium), and working
with data. It comes before this volume.

**Volume 3**, *Industry Practice*, covers de-identification and
ethics, statistical analysis plans, testing and continuous
integration, and the pharmaceutical industry chapters (CDISC and
SAS). It is the one-quarter supplement for pharmaceutical-track
students.

Cross-references within this volume work as usual. A reference to
material in another volume is written as plain text, using that
volume's own chapter numbers, for example 'Chapter 5 ('Why
Reproducible Research') in Volume 1'. We do this because a printed
volume cannot link into a book it is not bound with.
